subject.title: fix(cli): reject --channel/--to for systemEvent cron jobs with a clear error

question: Should cron add/edit immediately fail when explicit chat-delivery flags target a resulting main-session system event, despite previously accepting and discarding those flags?
rationale: The patch is technically consistent with the runtime contract, but it intentionally turns previously successful CLI invocations into errors and repository policy requires an owner to accept that operator compatibility impact.

options.title: Approve immediate fail-fast validation
options.body: Adopt the submitted invariant now so impossible delivery requests cannot silently create jobs that will not deliver as requested.

options.title: Require a deprecation window
options.body: Preserve the accepted invocation temporarily with a prominent warning, then switch to a hard error in a later release.

recommendation.title: Approve immediate fail-fast validation
recommendation.body: Adopt the submitted invariant now so impossible delivery requests cannot silently create jobs that will not deliver as requested.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent cron service, contract, and documentation history gives this owner the broadest context for the operator-facing compatibility decision.
